property_summary: After calling assertGovernanceApproved on behalf of a non-DAO/non-governed caller, the governed status of that caller remains false in the reference, but in the bug the length mismatch revert is skipped, so the caller becomes governed and assertGovernanceApproved stores a pending flash decision; reading governed[sender] after the call diverges.
change_summary: Replace the condition in the require statement to always succeed when governed status is false.
